versions.shortDescription: Compare multiple clustering outputs on the same dataset.
versions.longDescription:
Benchmark and compare multiple clustering predictions on the same dataset.

This app evaluates one or more clustering label columns against a shared feature matrix. It computes standard internal clustering metrics and, if ground-truth labels are provided, also computes external agreement metrics.

It is useful for comparing several clustering outputs side by side, ranking clustering runs by a chosen metric, and evaluating clustering quality with or without true labels.

What it does
------------
The app expects:
- a features table containing samples and feature columns,
- a predictions table containing one or more clustering label columns,
- optionally a ground_truth table containing reference labels.

For each prediction column, the app computes:
- Silhouette score
- Davies-Bouldin index
- Calinski-Harabasz score
- Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), if ground truth is provided
- Adjusted Mutual Information (AMI), if ground truth is provided

The result is a ranking table with one row per prediction column.

Inputs
------
Features:
Tabular input with one sample identifier column, or the sample identifier stored in the dataframe index. All remaining columns are treated as numeric feature columns.

Predictions:
Tabular input with one sample identifier column, or the sample identifier stored in the dataframe index, plus one or more prediction columns. Each prediction column is interpreted as one clustering result to benchmark.

Ground truth (optional):
Tabular input with one sample identifier column, or the sample identifier stored in the dataframe index, plus one label column defined by truth_label_column.

Hyperparameters
---------------
id_column : string, default=sample_id
    Name of the sample identifier column. If the column does not exist explicitly, the app also accepts it from the dataframe index. For example, if the ID is stored in the index, id_column can be set to index.

truth_label_column : string, default=true_label
    Column name in the ground_truth input that contains the reference labels.

sort_by : string, default=silhouette
    Metric used to sort the output table. Supported values are silhouette, davies_bouldin, calinski_harabasz, adjusted_rand, adjusted_mutual_info, or an empty string for no sorting.

    Note: davies_bouldin is sorted in ascending order because lower is better. All other metrics are sorted in descending order because higher is better.

Returns
-------
output : table
    A table with one row per prediction column.

    Typical columns include:
    - model
    - n_samples
    - n_clusters
    - silhouette
    - davies_bouldin
    - calinski_harabasz
    - adjusted_rand
    - adjusted_mutual_info

Alignment rules
---------------
All inputs are aligned by id_column.

The app expects:
- every feature row to have a matching prediction row,
- every prediction row to have a matching ground-truth row if ground_truth is provided.

If rows cannot be aligned completely, the app raises an error.

Notes and limitations
---------------------
Internal metrics require at least 2 clusters.
Internal metrics are not defined if there is only one cluster, or if the number of unique cluster labels is greater than or equal to the number of samples. In such cases, the corresponding metric is returned as null.
Feature columns should be numeric.

hyperparams.name: id_column
hyperparams.description: Column name used as unique sample identifier.

hyperparams.name: truth_label_column
hyperparams.description: Default label column name for clustering predictions.

hyperparams.name: sort_by
hyperparams.description: Metric used to rank clustering models.

input.name: features
input.description: Feature table as CSV, including the sample identifier column.

input.name: predictions
input.description: Prediction table as CSV, containing the sample identifier and one or more clustering result columns.

input.name: ground_truth
input.description: Optional ground truth table as CSV, containing the sample identifier and true label column.

output.name: output
output.description: Benchmark scores for all clustering prediction columns as CSV.
